# Reality and Inheritance

The Awtsmoos renews the world in every instant, bright;
Awtsmoos.com therefore renews each inherited claim by measurable light.

## Observed inheritance

- Live tunnel: `awt-awtsmoos-2184`, approved root `/Users/awtsmoos/work/awtsmoos.com`.
- Geelooy exists; repository is `main`, behind origin by two commits, with a heavily shared dirty tree. Unrelated work must not be reset.
- Complete 0240 and 0836 Heichelos archaeology layers were reread before production writes.
- `study-sheet-motion.css` is 97 lines, scoped beneath `body[data-study-sheet-open="true"]`, with no `!important`.
- `AutoScrollRoot.js` selects an inner root only when scroll extent and overflow prove it scrollable.
- `AutoScrollDocument.js` reads and writes the same resolved root.
- Package start command is `node index`; canonical HTTP default in `index.js` is 8080.
- `index.js` calls `warmRichCommentAuthority(dynamicServer)` before HTTP readiness.
- `richCommentWarmup.js` requires `packedStore` and `fs` dependencies; absent those, it returns skipped. Caller wiring must be proven before this counts as a cold-start repair.
- `/comment-tree` still combines native tree reads with imported-tree aggregation.

## REMAINING_WORK

1. Re-run auto-scroll unit contracts.
2. Re-run imported-style ownership and CSS-quality baselines.
3. Prove rich-comment warmup wiring and cold-start latency from a safe fresh app process.
4. Confirm port-8080 listener PID, command, route identity, and HTTP response.
5. Browser-measure auto-scroll start/countdown/cancel/pause/resume/stop/pace/end/restart.
6. Find a genuine production inner `.scroll-view-wrapper` root or document that no current route creates one.
7. Build active post CSS closure and classify active/dormant/legacy/dead/compatibility owners.
8. Verify Main Menu and every registered child on mobile and desktop.
9. Verify every Scribe's Lens control, persistence/reset, focus, scrolling, safe area, Escape, and reduced motion.
10. Verify Community success/empty/failure/retry/transient recovery and paragraph indexing truthfully.
11. Inventory and sweep user-facing Heichel routes at required widths, LTR/RTL, long/short content, loading/empty/error.
12. Inventory and sweep standalone Social beyond feed core while proving `.awtsmoos-social-root` containment.
13. Repair only reproduced defects by complete-file rewrites and small modules.
14. Run syntax and relevant package suites after repair clusters.
15. Re-scan active CSS ownership, `!important`, fixed/z-index collisions, overflow, focus, and reduced motion.
16. Re-read every modified source file and audit line counts/tabs.
17. Write final implementation readback, browser verification, and completion delta in the original 0240 folder without collision.
18. Keep REMAINING_WORK open until every completion gate has evidence or an exact external blocker.

## NEXT_ACTION

Run baseline unit/style tests and prove the rich-comment warmup call path before any production rewrite.
